kurz: Most baking powders fizz twice: once when it gets wet, and again in the heat.
bild_im_kopf: Like an alarm clock with a snooze button: it rings briefly when mixed, and then properly in the hot oven.
beobachtung: In the cold glass it fizzes a little; in the hot one, much more.
erklaerung: [[backpulver|Baking powder]] contains two acids: one reacts with water straight away, the other only with heat. That way the cake rises properly exactly when it is in the oven.
sicherheit: Hot water: adults do the pouring.
schritte: Put a teaspoon of baking powder in each glass.
Pour cold water into the first and hot water into the second.
